newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX index firms on year-end fund moves.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX index firms on year-end fund moves.

text.p: Major Slovak shares closed mixed in moderate trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Wednesday, with gains to refinery Slovnaft pushing the SAX index up 1.97 points to 173.50.
Most blue chips saw moderate activity on the floor but brokers characterised most of trades year-end tax swaps.
"We're seeing the revaluation of portfolios as still the main activity," Dusan Sykora of ING Barings said.
Slovnaft closed up 95 crowns at 799 while steel maker VSZ closed down 42 crowns. Commercial bank VUB eased 50 crowns to 1,650.
"It's hard to say where is the real price level in nearly every issue at the moment, as they trade either significantly small volumes, or in the block swaps, agreed in advance," he added.
Overall volume climbed to 3,135,881 shares, from 759,875 shares traded on Tuesday, while turnover increased to 1.73 billion crowns, from 581.88 million.
